resources.string: Everything stays on this device. Nothing is sent anywhere, and secrets are never shown.
This bucket strongly delays periodic work.
Your phone (%1$s) is known to kill background apps
Settings › Apps › Manage apps › TokenUsage: enable Autostart, set Battery saver to “No restrictions”, and lock the app in the recent apps list.
Settings › Battery › App launch › TokenUsage: switch to manual management and allow auto-launch, secondary launch and run in background.
Settings › Battery › TokenUsage: allow background activity and auto-launch, and lock the app in the recent apps list.
Settings › Battery › Background power consumption › TokenUsage: allow high background power consumption, and enable Autostart in i Manager.
Settings › Battery › Background usage limits: remove TokenUsage from “Sleeping apps” and “Deep sleeping apps”, and add it to “Never sleeping apps”.
Settings › Battery › Battery optimization › TokenUsage: choose “Don’t optimize”, and enable Allow background activity and Auto-launch.
Check your phone’s battery settings and exempt TokenUsage from battery optimization and background restrictions.
